summary: The official Uttar Pradesh Bhunaksha viewer was inspected and queried anonymously for Bagpat district, Baraut tehsil, and a Baraut-named revenue village. Public village metadata, EPSG:32644 extent, and safe native plot IDs/bounding boxes were returned, but no full polygon was available from the anonymous routes tested; no sample GeoJSON was written.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery was performed and recorded in city-8478-baraut.json. All executed viewer and dashboard requests, statuses, parameters, returned schema/CRS, and access limitation are recorded there. No login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe lookup, or TLS-verification disablement was used.
cityOrLocalCustodian: The UP Bhunaksha public map service is first-party state cadastral-map evidence applicable to Baraut tehsil. The Baghpat district administration site is a district custodian directory. No city municipal parcel registry endpoint was independently verified.
routesAttempted: See city-8478-baraut.json requests array; routes include level-value metadata, georeferenced extent, plot-by-number, plot-at-XY, plot-info, and the authorization-protected alternate plot endpoint.
schemaAndCrs: Observed extent schema included xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, attribution, scaleFactor, crs, and gisCode; CRS was EPSG:32644. Plot lookup schema included minx, miny, maxx, maxy, id, and kide. Full polygon schema was not observed.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed against a verified full-polygon endpoint; no absence inference.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official UP cadastral-map service for Baraut tehsil and selected revenue village.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Tehsil village metadata plus one village extent and three safe plot identities/bounding boxes.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point [29.0948108151882, 77.2644039307663] was preserved without coordinate shifting. The selected revenue-village extent is not a city boundary, and an authorization wall or missing plot-info response is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
integrationDisposition: Research packet only; not source integration or admission. No registry/catalog/runtime files were changed.
